rules.title: The Docker daemon is unavailable
rules.summary: The client cannot reach the configured Docker engine.

any: Cannot connect to the Docker daemon
The system cannot find the file specified.*docker_engine

causes: Docker Desktop or the system daemon is not running.
DOCKER_HOST points to an unavailable engine.
The current user cannot access the daemon socket.
actions: Confirm the intended Docker engine is running.
Inspect the active Docker context and DOCKER_HOST.
Check socket permissions without making the socket world-writable.

rules.title: A container already uses that name
rules.summary: Docker requires container names to be unique, including stopped containers.

any: Conflict\. The container name .+ is already in use
container name .+ is already in use by container

causes: A previous container was stopped but not removed.
Two compose projects or scripts chose the same fixed name.
actions: Inspect the existing container and confirm whether it should be reused.
Remove or rename only that container if it is stale.
Prefer generated compose names when a fixed container_name is unnecessary.

rules.title: A published container port is already allocated
rules.summary: Docker cannot bind the requested host port because another listener owns it.

any: Bind for .+ failed: port is already allocated

causes: Another container publishes the same host port.
A local service is already listening there.
actions: List containers and host processes using the reported port.
Stop the stale owner or publish this container on a different host port.
